name: Wildbolt Step
description: Step in a zigzag of crackling wild qi that no straight blow can follow.

name: Static Fist
description: Strike with a fist that crackles and discharges in a random burst on contact.

name: Sparkscatter Guard
description: Scatter sparks of wild current before the forearm so a blow veers off at an unlooked-for angle.

name: Crackle Sense
description: Feel the crackle of loose current in a body or a field to learn where its charge builds.

name: Forked Havoc
description: Loose a bolt that forks by no rule into several arcs that strike at once.

name: Arc Snarl
description: Cast arcs of current that snarl round the foe's limbs and jerk them in wild directions.

name: Jitter Shock
description: Send a jittering shock into the foe that breaks the flow of the technique they are casting.

name: Erratic Current
description: Run an erratic current across the body that throws off blows and burns the hands of the striker.

name: Wild Lightning
description: Call down lightning that strikes no single mark but wanders the field in jagged hops.

name: Stormwild Lash
description: Whip a lash of ragged lightning that changes length and strength on every stroke.

name: Anarchic Thunderfall
description: Drop a thunderfall of chaos and current across the field in which no bolt repeats the last.

name: Unruled Thunder
description: streams: Chaos + Lightning; fork the chaos stream through the lightning stream until every bolt strikes by its own law and none is warded.

name: Chance Step
description: Take a step that leaves its landing to chance and so cannot be read by a watching foe.

name: Gambler's Palm
description: Strike with a palm that may land light or terribly hard and leave the foe unsure which.

name: Luck Guard
description: Turn a blow aside with a guard that seems always to be where the strike was not meant to land.

name: Odds Sense
description: Feel the shifting odds of the next exchange and learn which of the foe's moves is likeliest.

name: Twisted Odds
description: Twist the odds round the foe so that their best move falls flat and their worst succeeds.

name: Fate Snag
description: Snag the thread that leads a foe's move to its end and tie it into a knot.

name: Random Verdict
description: Strike with a blow whose force is decided only by the instant of contact.

name: Skewed Destiny
description: Hold a ward that skews the destined course of every blow thrown toward the user.

name: Unwritten Blow
description: Deliver a blow that was written into no fate and so meets no ward set against it.

name: Fate Storm
description: Raise a storm of unsettled fate that tosses the outcomes of every move within it.

name: Probability Rend
description: Rend the likely course of events in a wide field so that no foe can rely on any plan.

name: Fate Unspun
description: Unspin the thread of fate from every foe in a wide field until their outcomes lie loose.

name: Fate Unsettled
description: streams: Fate + Chaos; churn the fate stream in the chaos stream so what was destined is left open and outcomes are thrown loose.

name: Gustwild Step
description: Skip across the ground on a gust of wild air that drops the body in an unlooked-for spot.

name: Windmad Fist
description: Throw a fist spun mad by the wind so that it arrives from a new angle each time.

name: Tatter Guard
description: Tatter the air before the body into ragged shreds that tear blows into pieces.

name: Wildgust Sense
description: Read the random gusts round a foe to find the quarter from which their next move will come.

name: Whirligig Burst
description: Burst a whirligig of chaos wind that spins foes about and flings them apart.

name: Windshear Tangle
description: Tie the foe in crossing shears of wind that pull their limbs in opposite ways.

name: Cyclone Quirk
description: Spin a small mad cyclone round the foe's head that spoils their sight and sense of balance.

name: Eddy Snap
description: Snap the arm through a wild eddy of wind and strike the foe off their line.

name: Mad Cyclone
description: Raise a cyclone that reverses its turning at random and flings foes in changing directions.

name: Shearing Chaos
description: Shear a thin blade of wild wind through the guard in a stroke that cannot be read.

name: Gale Rupture
description: Rupture the air itself in a burst of gale and chaos that breaks formations.

name: Unmoored Tempest
description: Cut a tempest loose from every law of wind and hurl it as a mass of colliding currents.

name: Stormbreak Entropy
description: streams: Chaos + Wind; unwind the wind stream through the chaos stream until the storm tears itself and all within it apart.

name: Cyclone of Whim
description: streams: Chaos + Wind; let the chaos stream steer the wind stream as a cyclone that changes mind with every breath.
